author: PosteGamer
body:
Hi! I was thinking some suggestions for the friends because it doesnt have any use.


Private and Group chat:

If you add someone as Friend you can have  a private chat to talk with him; and, you can add another person and create a Group Chat.



Give Credits:

You can give credits to a friend, it can be with a command like this /give [NAME] [Credits]. Example: /give Bloodoh 10000



Alert when he / she join in the server:


When anyone of your friends join Avicus you will be alert (Than OCN).



¿Do you have more ideas? Tell its in the comments bellow

replies.author: ImNotYourTiger
replies.body: I like the credits idea, but the group chats with friends isn't really necessary, as you have many forms of communication (teamspeak, forums, avicus server, etc.) that is more than efficient. When you say a group chat do you mean on the forums or on the actual server? And being alerted when a friend joins can be annoying. What if a bunch of your friends join every 5 minutes, or the server is lagging and their disconnecting and reconnecting and its filling up the chat, or you friend is trolling you? You need to think this through, and the negative effects, not just the greater outcome. Overall you had the idea going though and I liked how you were thinking.
